request_fields: task prompt (paper Table 8: Moderna COVID-19 vaccine interaction, answer yes/no) + question
notes: Benchmark exists only as part of the ClinicBench release (Liu et al., EMNLP 2024; ClinicBench is the suite and the own release). Prompt text per task is in Table 8 of the paper (https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.759.pdf); the release ships items without the prompt. 200 yes/no questions, all about Moderna COVID-19 Vaccine combined with another drug (derived from Drugs.com per the paper); matches the 200 reported in Table 1. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: Item text as released (the yes/no question); the ClinicBench Table 8 prompt was not applied because it contains an unpublished placeholder "(introduce what each Moderna COVID-19 Vaccine is ...)".
